title: Tim Dooley Quantum, Atom, Particle and Topology Recovery
epistemic_rule: This file distinguishes (a) recovered conversation-developed Timic equations and mappings, (b) repository-built physics layers, and (c) established external physics. A conversation-developed formalism is not automatically a claim Tim published or experimentally validated.

This is preserved as a cross-scale symbolic hypothesis, not as evidence that one physical force governs all those structures.
